verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gadrabho gogaṇaṁ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho hoti:
verses.english: “Suppose, mendicants, a donkey followed behind a herd of cattle, thinking:
‘I can moo too! I can moo too!’

verses.pali: Tassa na tādiso vaṇṇo hoti seyyathāpi gunnaṁ, na tādiso saro hoti seyyathāpi gunnaṁ, na tādisaṁ padaṁ hoti seyyathāpi gunnaṁ.
verses.english: But it doesn’t look like a cow, or sound like a cow, or leave a footprint like a cow.

verses.pali: So gogaṇaṁyeva piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho hoti:
verses.english: Still it follows behind a herd of cattle, thinking:
‘I can moo too! I can moo too!’

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu bhikkhusaṅghaṁ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho hoti:
verses.english: In the same way, some mendicant follows behind the mendicant Saṅgha, thinking:
‘I’m a monk too! I’m a monk too!’

verses.pali: Tassa na tādiso chando hoti adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne seyyathāpi aññesaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ, na tādiso chando hoti adhicittasikkhāsamādāne seyyathāpi aññesaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ, na tādiso chando hoti adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne seyyathāpi aññesaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ.
verses.english: But they don’t have the same enthusiasm for undertaking the training in the higher ethics, the higher mind, and the higher wisdom as the other mendicants.

verses.pali: So bhikkhusaṅghaṁyeva piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho hoti:
verses.english: Still they follow behind the mendicant Saṇgha, thinking:
‘I’m a monk too! I’m a monk too!’
So you should train like this:

verses.pali: ‘tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo no chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo no chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne’ti.
verses.english: ‘We will have keen enthusiasm for undertaking the training in the higher ethics, the higher mind, and the higher wisdom.’
